channel.title: Blockchain Today
channel.description: Blockchain Today reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and network upgrades, with analysis of what changed.

item.title: DTCC launches tokenization service for $30 trillion in securities
item.description: DTCC launched tokenized versions of 34 securities across two networks, bringing a $30 trillion pool within reach of approved firms while keeping custody at DTC.

item.title: Ripple says OCC finalized national trust bank charter
item.description: Ripple says its trust bank has final OCC approval, adding federal supervision to RLUSD’s reserve management while its New York trust company continues issuance.

item.title: Aviva adds XRP Ledger share class to £22bn sterling fund
item.description: Aviva and Ripple put a sterling fund share class on XRP Ledger, extending a July dollar launch while leaving the £22bn fund’s assets and structure off-chain.

item.title: Aviva adds £22bn sterling fund share class to XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors has put a tokenised share class of its £22bn sterling liquidity fund on XRPL, extending its Ripple partnership while keeping the fund structure off-chain.

item.title: Wall Street banks move tokenized deposits toward live use
item.description: Wells Fargo plans tokenized deposits for corporate clients, adding to bank blockchain services that promise around-the-clock transfers but depend on connecting separate networks.

item.title: Kraken wins Kazakhstan approval, but licence remains ahead
item.description: AFSA has advanced Kraken parent Payward’s Kazakhstan application for trading, dealing and custody, but a full licence and customer launch still lie ahead.

item.title: SushiSwap trades and liquidity: how the costs work
item.description: SushiSwap uses automated pools to set prices and route trades; the fee, gas cost and liquidity risks depend on the pool type and the assets you choose.

item.title: HSBC brings HKD stablecoin RedCoin to PayMe users
item.description: HSBC has launched its HKD stablecoin through PayMe, giving more than 3.3 million users a new payment option while setting up a test of retail demand and trust.

item.title: Tether’s MDK draws 15 mining firms into shared software layer
item.description: Tether says 15 mining operators, hardware makers and pools will build MDK integrations, a bid to make Bitcoin mining systems easier to automate across vendors.

item.title: Limit order or buy now? Price, certainty and event shares
item.description: A limit order sets the most you will pay but may never fill; buying now crosses the available asks. The choice depends on price, depth and urgency.

item.title: OCC leaves crypto exchange stablecoin rewards open case by case
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars issuers from paying stablecoin interest but leaves exchange rewards subject to case-by-case scrutiny and anti-evasion powers.

item.title: How to Move Rollup Balances to Ethereum Cold Storage
item.description: Moving rollup balances to cold storage means selecting each exit path, budgeting for gas and delays, and checking the final assets on Ethereum before signing off.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s new GENIUS Act rule keeps rewards programs under case-by-case review, leaving crypto platforms room to offer them and banks uncertain about limits.

item.title: Rebalancing a Crypto Wallet Starts With Target Weights
item.description: A useful rebalance starts with target weights, measures each token’s dollar drift, then trades only what is needed after fees, liquidity and execution timing.

item.title: Fund the Market Before the Order: How Prediction Deposits Work
item.description: Funding ahead of a trade means matching the market’s accepted payment method, asset and network, then allowing time for transfers or conversions to clear.

item.title: Rango bridge routes: compare the path before you send
item.description: Rango bridge routes combine swaps and transfers across chains; compare net output, fees, timing and providers before signing, then track delivery.

item.title: Standard Chartered signs deal to buy Zodia Custody
item.description: Standard Chartered has signed a deal to acquire Zodia Custody, bringing its regulated custody business into the bank while separating its software operation.

item.title: Three Checks Before Canceling a Partly Filled CoW Swap Order
item.description: A partial fill leaves only part of a CoW Swap order open. Check what settled, whether cancellation has cleared, and what each cancellation route can cost.

item.title: How a tron swap moves TRC-20 tokens—and what it costs
item.description: A TRON swap moves value through token contracts and liquidity pools; approval, Energy costs, routing and slippage determine what arrives and what the trade really costs.

item.title: TRON Energy: What a Contract Call Actually Costs
item.description: TRON Energy pays for smart contract execution, but the amount depends on the call, available resources and any developer subsidy; estimate each transaction before sending.
